jobs.subject: WHITE KING: ivory body, rich gold trim, gold cross on the distinctive heart-shaped crown, amber diamond on crown and base, soft golden magic
jobs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production chess game animation sprite sheet. The supplied local image is ONLY the identity/style reference showing 4 idle variations of one chess piece. Create ONE clean animation sheet for exactly that same WHITE KING: ivory body, rich gold trim, gold cross on the distinctive heart-shaped crown, amber diamond on crown and base, soft golden magic. Preserve its silhouette, crown, proportions, ornaments, gemstone shapes, glossy painterly 2D fantasy rendering and dark brown outlines. No redesign and no other chess piece.
MANDATORY LAYOUT: square canvas, a precise 2 by 2 grid of four equal square cells, reading order top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right. No drawn grid lines, borders, numbers, text, UI, watermark or labels. Each cell is an isolated full sprite on genuine alpha TRANSPARENT background, not black or a colored/opaque backdrop. Keep every pixel of each sprite/effect inside its cell with at least 10 percent clear padding. Same fixed camera and same scale/registration in all cells, center x at 50% and base at 85% of cell. Do not let glows or fragments touch adjacent cells.
ANIMATION: four coherent consecutive frames of a calm floating/sliding locomotion loop. Frame 1: upright at neutral height, faint gold ring tight around base. Frame 2: gently rises by 3% of cell, leans only 3 degrees toward right, thin short gold trailing wisps near base. Frame 3: at highest point 5% up, returns almost upright, wisps subtly shifted. Frame 4: settles toward frame 1 height, upright, ring fading. It stays intact in all frames. This is quiet movement: NO attack, NO big swoosh, NO impact starburst, NO explosion, NO cracks, NO cut body. Keep full body recognizable in every cell.
